paragraphs: ePermitHub sells software for construction permitting and plan review, aimed at cutting the time government agencies and the construction industry spend on permitting. The main product is a web-based digital plan review service for government permitting agencies of all sizes, covering document management from intake to approval and beyond. The Digital Plan Room creates collaborative plan review workflows and is described as reducing turn-around times while checking code compliance.

The platform integrates government permitting processes into BIM and construction management tools. A plug-in brings document management and plan review into the Accela Civic Platform, and further plug-ins for other permitting platforms are listed as coming soon.

Case studies on the site name Pinellas County, the City of DeLand, and the City of Tampa. Testimonials are attributed to a chief building official in Hillsborough County, a technology services director in the City of Weston, and a permit supervisor in the City of Sparks. The pages present government agencies and construction professionals as the parties served.

quote.text: Our solutions for government and the construction industry exponentially reduce time spent on construction permitting.
